title: A returned-parts credit on a part sale goes to the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new part sale for this test, part sale 1, for customer A, invoiced for one part sold at $80.00, unpaid, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open part sale 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Issue Credit on the invoice.
  4. Tick the part to return.
  5. Confirm the credit.
  6. Open customer B's page.
  7. Open customer A's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab lists the invoice.

Step 3:

  • The Issue Credit window opens.

Step 4:

  • The part is ticked.

Step 5:

  • The credit for the returned part is made.

Step 6:

  • Customer B's credits show the $80.00 credit for part sale 1.

Step 7:

  • Customer A's credits show no credit for part sale 1.
